comment: Performance budgets (R-PERF-1, R-PERF-2; tools/perf.py, check C-PERF). `milestone` names the budgets in force. Sizes are bytes: code (code and constants in the image), static_ram (initialised and zeroed data), stack_high_water (the deepest the stack went in the perf runs). Since M2's method: startup_instructions (the one-off core-0 instructions before the firmware settles) and steady_per_period (core-0 instructions per period in steady state). speed_rise_percent: the most steady-state instructions per period may rise against the latest main record made under the same steady_per_period budget. Raising a budget, or moving to the next milestone's, takes its own pull request that says why (What/Why/How/Result), with nothing else in it.
